source.capturedWith: tests/fixtures/polytician-3.0/capture.mjs: spawns the server over stdio (newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0), each run with a fresh temporary POLYTICIAN_DATA_DIR and HOME, no inherited POLYTICIAN_* settings, POLYTICIAN_NLP_PIPELINE=rule-based and the embedding model copied in from a local cache. The client identifies as AgentVault does (protocolVersion 2024-11-05, clientInfo agentvault 1.0.0).

volatile.conceptIds: Concept ids (UUID v4) are replaced, everywhere including content[0].text and error messages, by stable UUIDs 11111111-1111-4111-8111-00000000000N in the order the concepts were created; ids the server generated but never stored (a rejected save) become 22222222-2222-4222-8222-00000000000N.
volatile.timestamps: createdAt/updatedAt are epoch milliseconds (numbers, not ISO strings); they are replaced by 1791072000000 (2026-10-04T00:00:00.000Z), so list_concepts order (updatedAt descending) shows only in the array order.
volatile.agentVaultPort: The closed loopback port the vault_* run points at is replaced by <agentvault-port>.
volatile.modelDependent: search scores and the embedding arrays in save_concept/read_concept responses are real Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (q8) output: assert ranges, order and length (384), not exact floats.
volatile.runtimeDependent: UPSTREAM_ERROR messages for an unreachable AgentVault ("fetch failed") come from the Node.js fetch implementation.

initialize.note: Written at spawn time, before the server has opened its transport; the pipe buffers it and the server answers once ready.

stdinClosed.note: Closing stdin is enough to stop the server.

initializeWithoutInitializedNotification.note: initialize, then tools/list and tools/call with no notifications/initialized (AgentVault's client today).

noInitialize.note: tools/list and tools/call without any initialize request.

startupFailure.note: POLYTICIAN_AV_API_URL=http://example.com (plain http off loopback) is a configuration error: the process exits before answering, so a client must fail pending requests when the process closes instead of waiting for its request timeout.

tools.name: save_concept
tools.description: Create or update a concept with one or more representations (vector, markdown, thoughtform). A new concept needs at least one. Tags are merged on update. The vector is derived from the text unless autoEmbed is false. An update must name the namespace the concept lives in; expectedVersion guards against concurrent writers. Each representation written records its provenance (source), and a concept can carry an assertionStatus and ledgerRef.

expectedVersion.description: Expected current version. The write is rejected with VERSION_CONFLICT unless it matches.

thoughtform.description: ThoughtForm JSON: the native shape (ISO timestamps, entities with text) or a PolyVault v1 ThoughtForm

embedding.description: Vector embedding (384 finite numbers, not all zero)

tags.description: Tags, merged on update (at most 64, each 128 characters or fewer)

origin.description: "user" (default) for content written by the caller, "import" for content copied from another system

createdBy.description: Who wrote the content (an agent, person or system); recorded as given, not authenticated

model.description: Model that wrote the content, if the caller knows it

source.description: Provenance recorded on the representations this call writes (default origin "user")

assertionStatus.description: Truth status of a concept that records a claim (e.g. a stenographer TB/UV entry); null clears it, omitted keeps it. Stored as given, not checked.

ledgerRef.description: The ledger entry this concept mirrors (id, path#id or hash); null clears it

namespace.description: Namespace (default: "default"). Must be in POLYTICIAN_NAMESPACES when the operator set one.

autoEmbed.description: Derive the vector from the markdown (else the thoughtform text) when no embedding is given, so the concept is searchable (default true). Never replaces a caller-supplied vector.

tools.name: read_concept
tools.description: Read all available representations for a concept in a namespace, with their provenance, assertionStatus and ledgerRef. Optionally filter to specific representations.

namespace.description: Namespace (default: "default"). Must be in POLYTICIAN_NAMESPACES when the operator set one.

tools.name: delete_concept
tools.description: Delete a concept (in the given namespace) and all its representations.

namespace.description: Namespace (default: "default"). Must be in POLYTICIAN_NAMESPACES when the operator set one.

tools.name: list_concepts
tools.description: List concepts with pagination and optional tag (exact match) and assertionStatus filtering. Results are scoped to the namespace.

namespace.description: Namespace (default: "default"). Must be in POLYTICIAN_NAMESPACES when the operator set one.

tags.description: Only concepts carrying every one of these tags

assertionStatus.description: Only concepts whose assertionStatus is one of these (concepts without one are left out)

tools.name: search_concepts
tools.description: Semantic similarity search over one namespace. Provide a text query (auto-embedded) or a raw vector. Namespace, tag and assertionStatus filters are applied inside the vector search. Returns { results }, each with score = (1 + cosine similarity) / 2 in [0, 1], best first, ties by id. crossNamespace (without namespace) searches the namespaces the operator allowed via POLYTICIAN_NAMESPACES and is refused if none are configured.

tags.description: Only concepts carrying every one of these tags

assertionStatus.description: Only concepts whose assertionStatus is one of these (concepts without one are left out)

namespace.description: Namespace (default: "default"). Must be in POLYTICIAN_NAMESPACES when the operator set one.

crossNamespace.description: Search every namespace the operator allowed (POLYTICIAN_NAMESPACES) instead of one; cannot be combined with namespace

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Server status, embedding model status, DB stats for a namespace, LLM provider status.

namespace.description: Namespace (default: "default"). Must be in POLYTICIAN_NAMESPACES when the operator set one.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Concept count, vector count, representation breakdown for a namespace.

namespace.description: Namespace (default: "default"). Must be in POLYTICIAN_NAMESPACES when the operator set one.

vaultTools.name: vault_infer
vaultTools.description: Run a prompt through AgentVault's inference fallback chain (Bittensor -> Venice AI -> local) and optionally save the result as a concept (provenance origin "llm").

prompt.description: Prompt text to send to the inference chain

saveAsConceptNamespace.description: If set, save the inference result as a markdown concept in this namespace

vaultTools.name: vault_memory_push
vaultTools.description: Push a Polytician concept to AgentVault's memory_repo canister immediately.

vaultTools.name: vault_memory_pull
vaultTools.description: Pull markdown entries from AgentVault's memory_repo branch into concepts in one namespace (provenance origin "import"), last write wins: an entry replaces a local concept only when its updatedAt is newer, entries recorded for another namespace (or whose id lives in another namespace) are skipped, and ids must be UUIDs. Skipped entries are reported with a reason.

vaultTools.name: vault_archive_concept
vaultTools.description: Archive the current version of a concept to Arweave via AgentVault: permanent, public and paid, so it cannot be undone. The content is encrypted with the backup key before upload. Only concepts carrying every archival tag (archive) can be archived, and each version is archived once. Returns the Arweave transaction ID and URL.

vaultTools.name: vault_get_secret
vaultTools.description: Retrieve a named secret from AgentVault's secret provider. Returns metadata only, never the raw value.

vaultTools.name: vault_memory_repo_log
vaultTools.description: Read the current state of the AgentVault memory_repo branch Polytician syncs with (agentVault.memoryRepoBranch): its head and the keys of the concept entries on it, from every namespace. Takes no namespace.

health_check.cold.note: Before any embedding: the model loads lazily on the first save/search.

save_concept.note: The corrected orchestration save: markdown + tags. The response is the stored concept; its id is in structuredContent.id.
